limits: The WebKit forced-colors slot is intentionally skipped because Playwright WebKit cannot emulate that preference; Chromium passes it.
Visibilitychange policy uses a synthetic document-hidden signal; offscreen pause uses actual browser intersection/scrolling.
Automated axe and keyboard checks do not establish screen-reader speech, physical mobile GPU performance, all browsers or production OpenGym adoption.
No Apple native UI, physical sensors, workout state, Health or paired transport changes are included in this browser scope.
resolved_findings: Reader originally rejected a valid compiler duplicate endpoint timestamp; real squat rendering caught it and final tests pass.
RTL current/total visual clock now stays LTR instead of reversing duration order.
Dark-theme credits link originally failed contrast in both browsers; inherited host text color retains underline and passes final axe scans.
Forced-colors initial test used programmatic focus after mouse input; corrected to real Tab so focus-visible testing reflects keyboard behavior.
Unavailable copy no longer promises that the host original media is itself available: the final default reads Movement preview unavailable.

Long translated host instructions previously separated Play from the canvas, so reaching Play could immediately trigger offscreen pause. Playback controls now directly follow the canvas; both engines pass the 390x844 long-German-instructions regression.

visual_review.method: Each final PNG was opened and visually inspected after the passing 44-slot browser run.
observations: Standard and packaged previews show rendered anatomy with native controls immediately below the canvas; text and credits remain visible.
At 320 CSS pixels and 200% text, labels and camera controls wrap without clipping or horizontal overflow.
Long Arabic labels reflow in RTL; the current/total numeric clock preserves left-to-right ordering.
Dark captures retain readable instructions, controls and underlined attribution; Chromium forced colors retains visible keyboard focus.
Both EML 1.0 legacy captures show rendered anatomy and matching descriptions.
At 390 by 844 CSS pixels, long German host instructions follow the controls; the canvas and Play/Pause remain visible while playback advances.
visual_review.scope: Selected standalone integration fixture states, not a full OpenGym product audit, physical device review or screen-reader speech validation.
